text:
Maya: Heads-up: I accidentally bumped the semver in deploy config to 3.0.0 and the YAML parser cried. :cry_cat:
Devin: wait what... semver in YAML? show me the snippet
Maya: ```yaml
service:
  name: inference
  version: 3.0.0 # ?!
  autoscale: true
```
Devin: lol that's the `image.tag`, not the app semver. classic. :joy:
Sahil: @Maya did you run `yaml-lint`? the parser error might be from an en-dash or invisible tab
Maya: I ran it, but my editor auto-replaced `-` with ‘–’ (en dash). The parser is a drama queen. :tophat:
Lina: Pro tip: `yq` + `jq` are like therapy for YAML trauma. also `git blame` is the root cause 80% of the time :stuck_out_tongue:
Bryan: poll: what's worse? 1) bad semver in config 2) invisible tabs 3) YAML lists that bite back. React with :one: :two: :three:
Devin: :one: all day
DeployBot: Parse error in /infra/service.yaml at line 12 — unexpected en dash. (auto-filed #issue-492)
Maya: ok taking responsibility. opening PR that replaces en dash with hyphen and removes rogue semver. sorry for the :sos: moment.
Sahil: also rename the file to `service.yaml.orig.borked` so future archaeologists have context :skull:
Lina: we should add a pre-commit hook to lint versions: `pre-commit run --all-files`
Bryan: also, new team t-shirt idea: 'I survived YAML and all I got was this semver' :tshirt:
